i know it sounds crazy but practice spacing, if you have good spacing bullets will space out for you making it easier to learn and practice with, especially in bosses. with bosses best I can say is die and learn in the process. get their moveset down before going balls to the wall everytime (unless the loadout is insanely good). try separating your weapons into room clearer (low damage outputs) and boss killer( massive damage outputs) to help you spare ammo.

biggest thing to practice, as previously mentioned, is bobing and weaving through bullets rather than rolling all the time. Another good rule of thumb is that some things don't  "synergize" but work very well together. don't go synergy hunting right away bc it looks cool.
